therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Interferon receptor activation leading to antiviral and antiproliferative signaling
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Immune system activation and tumor cell growth inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Participants with Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia, Malignant Melanoma, or Renal Cell Carcinoma who had responded to interferon in prior studies
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of Participants With Serious Adverse Events
